notes: Text to Video presentation now depends on the view. In Timeline view it opens as a modal (widened 620px -> 760px so the bigger script box has room); in Scene (list) view it renders inline within the page — a card in the normal flow, no dark overlay — matching how it worked before it became a modal. Added openTextToVideo() dispatcher keyed on getSceneViewMode() (both the tab-bar CTA and the Timeline-editor button call it); inline mode is a new #textToVideoModal.ttv-inline class (position:static, transparent, in-flow) while timeline keeps the .open overlay (z-index 1400, above the 1200 editor). setSceneViewMode() re-dispatches an already-open panel so toggling List<->Timeline keeps it in the right form. Verified both presentations, the 760px width at desktop widths, the inline card in list view, and the live view-switch conversion; no console errors.
